# 504. Base 7

## Solution 1 (time O(log(n)), space O(1))

```python
class Solution(object):
    def convertToBase7(self, num):
        """
        :type num: int
        :rtype: str
        """
        if num == 0:
            return "0"
        is_neg = False
        if num < 0:
            is_neg = True
            num = -num
        ans = ""
        while num:
            ans += str(num % 7)
            num = num // 7
        return "-" + ans[::-1] if is_neg else ans[::-1]
```
